analyst.description: Frames problems, explores orthogonal solution families, and exposes decisions

planner.description: Produces approved-direction software architecture and implementation structure

explorer.description: Performs fast read-only repository exploration with file and line evidence

builder-junior.description: Executes explicit mechanical low-risk edits with minimal scope

builder-senior.description: Implements bounded normal development tasks and proportionate verification

reviewer.description: Performs an independent, read-only review against the approved definition and repository constraints

shipper.description: Verifies shipping preconditions, creates a focused commit, and pushes the current branch
